entry_state: Dated authority, scope, facts and elections govern rule selection. Historical US amendments do not establish current Codification admission, and ASBE lease adoption and tax transition have separate dates. Ping An's adoption, later carrying balances and maturity amounts constrain different questions; its dashes and qualified major-contract statement do not establish absent leases. The chapter's matched-case conclusion remains to be read.
exit_state: Chapter 9 closes with the consequence of changing a framework, withholding adoption evidence, changing the reporting year or merely renaming a label. The operating methods and real-disclosure tests support specific conditional treatments, while current authority, entity elections and broader method coverage remain open. The next chapter will extend the company through financing, ownership and reporting boundaries.
findings: The final comparison preserves different expense/ROU paths and source strength rather than equating frameworks by label.
Broader authority and actual-entity evidence remain internal work; no whole-company or compliance acceptance follows. No additional confirmed defect in Chapter 9.
